expert_source.initialization: madvise(MADV_WILLNEED) followed by one volatile byte read per 4 KiB page before benchmark phase timing
expert_source.transfer_path_on_expert_miss: resident file-backed mapping -> memcpy into CUDA pinned staging buffer -> asynchronous H2D
expert_source.semantic_note: The mapped physical pages are Linux file page-cache pages and can theoretically be reclaimed. This is an explicit resident-DRAM access path, but it is not an mlocked anonymous host-memory copy.

state_control.environment_policy: env -i with only PATH, HOME, LANG, CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES, LD_LIBRARY_PATH, and LLAMA_MOE_EXPERT_SOURCE
state_control.page_cache_policy: Intentionally retained because this experiment requires the full mapped model to be resident before timed expert transfers.

runtime_evidence.proc_io_note: rchar was unchanged across two samples during expert execution; mmap memory reads do not increment the legacy logical SSD read counter as file reads.

result.legacy_label_note: The summary labels ssd_read, SSD reads, and SSD bytes read are unchanged profiler names. In this run they count mmap-to-pinned DRAM memcpy operations, not physical SSD reads.

comparison_to_pure_cold.baseline_source: fseek+fread from a fully resident Linux page cache into pinned staging, then H2D
comparison_to_pure_cold.interpretation: LRU decisions did not change: cache hit rates, route coverage, logical expert bytes, and read count match the baseline. Prefill improved because mmap memcpy avoided the high batched fseek/fread cost. Decode regressed together with both host-copy and H2D timings. With one unbound run, the data cannot separate implementation cost from CPU/NUMA placement or shared-host scheduling variance.

validity.valid_for: A single-run pure-LRU comparison between resident-page-cache fread and explicit prefaulted file-backed mmap memcpy under fresh process, KV, and slot state.
validity.not_valid_for: Cold physical-SSD versus DRAM, an mlocked or anonymous full-model host copy, a repeated-run median, or NUMA-isolated host-memory and PCIe throughput.
important_limitations: Both this run and the cold baseline used physical pages already resident in the Linux file page cache.
No CPU/NUMA affinity was added in order to preserve the prior command shape; GPU 1 is local to NUMA node 0, while the process could run on CPUs 0-127.

The prior cold preflight reported GPU P8 at idle; this run reported P0 at idle. No clock setting was changed for this run, and both workloads execute at P0 under load, but this is still a recorded environment difference.
Only one run was requested, so the decode regression must not be presented as a stable population estimate.
